title: Alia Bhatt shares workout video, praised by fans
summary: Actress Alia Bhatt recently shared a video showcasing her intense workout routine, which included exercises like battle ropes and box jumps. Fans reacted positively to the video, with some referring to her as an 'Alpha mama' and praising her 'Alpha' physique. The content highlights her fitness regimen.
summary_points: Alia Bhatt posted a video of her high-intensity workout.
The workout featured exercises such as battle ropes and box jumps.
Fans responded positively to the video.
Some fans called her an 'Alpha mama'.
Her 'Alpha' body and fitness were subjects of fan comments.

वर्कआउट में बैटल रोप्स और बॉक्स जंप जैसे व्यायाम शामिल थे।
